name: help

lines.t: Select  click an object; drag to move it
Arrow   drag; elbow when not straight
Text    click, type, enter/esc to finish
Color: white red yellow green cyan magenta

│                     │  v     Select  click an object; drag to move it      │

│  t     Text    click, type, enter/esc to finish      │
